title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Software Engineer (Backend)

This role is based in Pune. This location works on a hybrid model, 2-3 days in the office. You will be required to interview in person.

**About SailPoint**

SailPoint is defining the next era of identity security. Our unified, AI-powered platform seamlessly secures both the Human Fabric of your workforce and the Agentic Fabric of AI and non-human identities, completely eliminating organizational blind spots.

Built on core principles like zero-standing privilege and contextualized risk, our platform transforms identity from a vulnerability into a strategic business advantage. Today, we are trusted by some of the largest, most complex organizations in the world to deliver intelligent, autonomous identity security at scale.

**About the Role**

SailPoint is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to help build a new cloud-based SaaS identity analytics product. We are looking for well-rounded backend or full stack engineers who are passionate about building and delivering reliable, scalable microservices and infrastructure for SaaS products. In this role, you will deliver efficient, maintainable, robust Java-based microservices, produce technical designs and rough estimates, implement features based on product requirements, and collaborate closely with peers on code reviews and testing.

**About the Team**

Our Engineering team is full of results-driven individuals who are constantly seeking to innovate and make an impact. We are where high-quality professional engineering meets individual impact. Our products are built on a mature, cloud-native event-driven microservices architecture hosted in AWS. As one of the early members on the team, you will be integral in building this product and will be part of an agile team operating in startup mode, backed by an established global leader.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* Bachelors degree in related field, or equivalent professional experience
* Strong Java experience and comprehensive understanding of Java frameworks
* Comprehensive experience with object-oriented analysis and design skills
* Comprehensive experience with object-oriented programming techniques
* Great communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills

​

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with AWS cloud services
* Experience with Continuous Delivery
* Experience working on a Big Data or Machine Learning product
* Experience instrumenting code for gathering production performance metrics

​

**Roadmap for Success**

* 30 Days: Complete onboarding, get familiar with the codebase, development environment, and architecture, and deliver your first code contribution.
* 60 Days: Actively participate in sprint planning, design discussions, and code reviews; build core microservice features and produce unit and end-to-end tests.
* 90 Days: Independently develop and deliver features, contribute to technical architecture discussions, and enhance automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
* 6 Months: Own key functional areas of the identity analytics product, instrument code to track production performance metrics, and collaborate cross-functionally to drive product reliability.
* 1 Year: Lead architectural enhancements for scalable microservices, drive best practices across the engineering team, and contribute to long-term technical strategy.

​
​

**About SailPoint India and our Benefits:**

Nestled in the heart of Pune, a bustling hub of technology and culture, the office exemplifies SailPoint's commitment to excellence. Surrounded by a vibrant atmosphere, the Pune office serves as a strategic center for the company, where cutting-edge solutions are crafted and implemented to address the ever-evolving challenges in identity security. With a team of highly skilled professionals, the office embodies SailPoint's values of Integrity, Innovation, Impact and Individuals. Our Pune team works under a hybrid model enjoying the office 2-3 days a week (unless otherwise specified). We provide excellent office amenities, competitive salaries and strong benefits:

* Our benefits program offers medical insurance for employees and their dependents, accident insurance and term life insurance for all employees. All premiums are paid by SailPoint.
* Company sponsored health-checkups for employees and discounted rates for dependents
* Annual performance bonus
* Restricted stock units at certain levels
* 24 Leaves every year in addition, 10 holidays
* Flexible Work hours

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

title: Software Engineer III- Eng
description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Engineer III- Eng to help build and operate scalable, enterprise-grade software systems used by organizations around the world. You will work across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and implementation to deployment and operations - delivering reliable, secure, and maintainable solutions in high-scale, compliance-sensitive environments.
  
  
This role is ideal for engineers who combine strong technical fundamentals with practical experience building distributed systems, modern cloud-native applications, and AI-augmented engineering workflows. You will leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering velocity and quality while applying sound engineering judgment, rigorous testing, and operational discipline.
  
  
You will collaborate closely with engineering, product, and platform teams to design systems that are scalable, resilient, observable, and built for long-term maintainability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Software Engineering:

Design, build, test, and maintain high-quality software systems and services. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with a strong focus on correctness, scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.
  
  

* Technical Ownership & Architecture:

Lead the technical design and delivery of distributed, enterprise-scale systems and services. Contribute to architecture reviews, service decomposition strategies, API design, event-driven integrations, and data modeling decisions that support scalability, maintainability, and resilience. Own services end-to-end, including implementation, CI/CD automation, deployment, observability, operational health, and ongoing production support.
  
  

* AI-Augmented Engineering:

Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar technologies as part of the engineering workflow to improve productivity, accelerate development, and enhance testing and documentation quality. Review and validate AI-generated output with strong engineering judgment, correctness, security, and maintainability standards.
  
  

* Code Quality & Testing:

Maintain a high bar for code quality through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing, and strong engineering practices. Build deterministic and scalable test suites covering unit, integration, contract, and edge-case scenarios across distributed systems.
  
  

* Reliability & Operations:

Monitor and improve the reliability, availability, and performance of production services. Use telemetry, logging, metrics, and operational insights to proactively identify and resolve issues in high-scale environments.
  
  

* Collaboration:

Work closely with cross-functional teams across engineering, product, security, and business stakeholders to deliver complex features and systems iteratively with high quality and operational excellence.
  
  

* Responsible AI:

Apply responsible AI principles when integrating AI-powered capabilities into products or workflows, including considerations for privacy, transparency, auditability, governance, and compliance.
  
  

* Documentation:

Create and maintain clear technical documentation for systems, APIs, operational processes, and business-critical logic to support long-term maintainability and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production-grade applications and services.
* Strong proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, Go, or Kotlin.
* Experience designing and operating distributed systems and microservices-based architectures.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, design patterns, testing methodologies, and system design principles.
* Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and event-driven integrations.
* Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server in transactional or high-scale environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms and containerized deployments using technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (GitHub), and Agile development workflows.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools as part of a modern software development workflow.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building and operating workloads on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with observability, monitoring, and production operations in large-scale distributed systems.
* Experience implementing automated testing strategies across unit, integration, and contract testing layers.
* Experience building systems in compliance-sensitive or business-critical domains.
* Experience integrating AI-powered capabilities such as LLM APIs, intelligent automation, or agentic workflows into production applications.
* Understanding of responsible AI principles, including governance, explain ability, privacy, and risk mitigation.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive projects independently and influence technical direction across teams.

**Company Overview**
UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com.
  
  
UKG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace, including the recruitment process.

description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Software Engineer
  
  
**Our Purpose**
We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible.
  
  
Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our Decency Quotient (DQ) drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, perspectives, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team, make better decisions, drive innovation, and deliver stronger business results.
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Network & Digital Payments group creates valued experiences for consumers and enables merchants and issuers to reach consumers in ways not possible in the pre-digital world.
  
  
The Global Product Engineering team is responsible for developing a suite of foundational payment solutions. This is an opportunity to be part of a highly motivated team focused on bringing security, convenience, and control to digital payments.
  
  
Ask Yourself
  
  

* Have you ever engineered a product to market on a global scale?
* Are you motivated to help drive a world beyond cash?
* Are you eager to work at the cutting edge of technology while maintaining a high standard of engineering excellence?

**Role Overview**
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:
  
  
Core Engineering Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and microservices architecture.
* Deploy and manage applications on PCF and/or Kubernetes.
* Develop engaging and responsive user interfaces using modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React.
* Participate in Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and contribute to the evaluation and selection of technologies, vendor solutions, frameworks, and methodologies.
* Write clean, maintainable, well-documented, and testable code.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver high-quality products.
* Participate in code reviews and continuously improve engineering practices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
* Ensure adequate test coverage across unit, integration, system, automation, and performance testing.
* Contribute to architecture and technical design decisions.
* Mentor junior engineers and share technical expertise.
* Work in an Agile environment, participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

Quality Engineering & Automation
  
  

* Develop robust automation solutions using Java, Spring, JUnit, Rest Assured, JBehave, Cucumber, or similar frameworks.
* Design and maintain automation frameworks, reusable utilities, harnesses, and engineering productivity tools.
* Create and maintain technical artifacts including:
* Design documents
* Test strategies
* Automation plans
* Integration specifications
* Operational readiness documentation
* Identify gaps across unit, functional, integration, regression, performance, and exploratory testing and partner with engineering teams to address them.
* Participate in defect triage, release readiness reviews, environment validation, and delivery risk assessments.

Security, Reliability & Operations
  
  

* Apply secure coding practices and support vulnerability identification using tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, or equivalent platforms.
* Support production readiness through effective logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, incident analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and issue resolution.
* Help improve application reliability, observability, and operational excellence.

**All About You**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 6 to 9 years of experience in Full Stack Software Development.
* Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience designing and developing microservices.
* Experience with PCF, Kubernetes (K8s), Docker, or cloud-native platforms.
* Strong understanding of front-end development principles with hands-on experience in Angular and/or React.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery.
* Hands-on experience with Java, Spring, JUnit, Rest Assured, JBehave, Cucumber, or equivalent testing frameworks.
* Strong experience validating APIs, microservices, web services, web applications, databases, and integration workflows.
* Experience with relational databases such as Oracle and PostgreSQL, including writing optimized and efficient SQL queries.
* Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Understanding of information security concepts, including:
* X.509 certificates
* Public key cryptography
* JWT (JSON Web Tokens)
* Hashing algorithms
* Digital signatures
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, data, and infrastructure layers.
* Strong passion for engineering excellence, continuous improvement, automation, and building reliable software at scale.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a collaborative team environment.

**Good To Have**

* Experience with public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
* Experience with DevOps practices and tools including Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Contributions to open-source projects.
* Experience in payment technologies, digital identity, authentication, or security-focused solutions.

**Our Teams & Values**

* We work in small, collaborative teams consisting of software engineers and product managers.
* Customer success is at the core of everything we do.
* We embrace diversity and inclusion, bringing together individuals from varied backgrounds and experiences.
* We believe in doing well by doing good through inclusive growth and ethical, environmentally responsible decision-making.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We have created an industry-leading API platform with comprehensive online tools and access, to meet the demands of daily business payments. We have two routes to market. Our Core Business Payments product allows customers in any sector to connect to us and our expanding network of accounting and payroll platforms, including Sage, Xero, BrightPay and IRIS to automate payments. We are deeply integrated into the payment eco-system. In the UK, we are direct participants of Faster Payments and Bacs. Modulr hold settlement accounts at the Bank of England. Our payment network connectivity includes CHAPS, Open Banking, SEPA, SWIFT and account issuance in multiple currencies. We are principal issuing members of Visa and Mastercard schemes across UK and Europe.
  
  
Our regulatory permissions and governance structure are the foundations of our business. We are regulated and supervised as an Authorised Electronic Money Institution (AEMI) in the UK by the Financial Conduct Authority and in the Netherlands by De Nederlandsche Bank.
  
  
Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by the venture arms of payments giants PayPal and FIS, as well as growth investors Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog Capital and Highland Europe.
  
  
Modulr now has over 400 employees spread globally across offices in London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam, Mumbai and Pune.

* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.

the best possible way. We operate in a tribes and squad model with each area focused on

Large Language Models (LLMs)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA

As a Large Language Model Developer, a typical day involves refining and adapting advanced language models to better suit specific domains and instructions. This role focuses on enhancing the model's ability to understand and generate contextually relevant responses by carefully adjusting its parameters and training data. The work requires continuous experimentation and evaluation to ensure the model performs optimally in targeted applications, contributing to the advancement of intelligent language processing systems.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:

* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate model improvements into production environments.
* Document methodologies and findings to support knowledge sharing and future development.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support in model development tasks.

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Experience in fine-tuning language models for instruction-based tasks and domain-specific adaptation.
* Strong understanding of natural language processing techniques and model evaluation metrics.
* Ability to work with large datasets and preprocess data for model training and validation.
* Familiarity with programming languages commonly used in machine learning workflows, such as Python.
* Experience with model deployment and performance monitoring in real-world applications.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Large Language Models (LLMs).
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Senior AI/DS Engineer
description:
**Designation :**
Senior AI/DS Engineer

**Required Experience:**

5-6 years overall with AI/ML, data science or applied AI; at least 5 years of hands-on AI/ML/data-science work and 2+ years of technical/team leadership.

**Job Description:**

Aventior is looking for a hands-on Team Lead - AI & Data Science to lead customer-facing AI and analytics engagements from discovery through production and ongoing improvement.

The role combines technical direction, people leadership, customer communication and delivery ownership. You will turn business problems into clear requirements, assess feasibility and data readiness, shape pragmatic AI/GenAI solutions, guide engineers and data scientists, and deliver secure, measurable outcomes in production.

The strongest candidate is equally comfortable discussing business value with a customer, explaining technical options and trade-offs, reviewing code or model quality, and managing scope, risks and delivery commitments.

**Key Responsibilities**

:

**1. Customer engagement, discovery and requirement gathering -**

●Lead customer and stakeholder discovery sessions, interviews and workshops to understand business goals, users, existing workflows, pain points, data sources, constraints and success criteria.

●Translate business needs into clear problem statements, functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies and measurable KPIs.

● Assess data availability, data quality, integration constraints, privacy/security requirements and technical feasibility before recommending an approach.

● Present solution options and trade-offs in business-friendly language, including build-versus-buy, model selection, expected value, risks, cost, latency and operational implications.

● Lead proof-of-concept planning, demos, review meetings and customer sign-off; manage clarifications, scope changes, priorities and expectation setting throughout the engagement.

**2. AI solution architecture and technical leadership**

● Own solution design across data ingestion and preparation, model or LLM selection, retrieval, orchestration, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and operational monitoring.

● Choose fit-for-purpose approaches for the business problem rather than defaulting to a particular model, vendor, framework or architecture pattern.

● Establish engineering standards through design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, reusable components, documentation and secure development practices.

● Remain hands-on for critical design decisions, prototypes, complex debugging and performance/cost optimisation while enabling the team to execute independently.

**3. Generative AI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows**

● Design and deliver LLM-powered applications using commercial APIs and/or managed or open models; apply prompt design, structured outputs, tool/function calling and workflow orchestration as appropriate.

● Build and improve RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, access-aware retrieval, source attribution and grounded answer generation.

● Select and apply agentic patterns only where they add value; define tool permissions, bounded actions, state transitions, approval steps, retries and safe failure behavior.

● Create systematic evaluation approaches for task success, groundedness, retrieval relevance, factuality, safety and user experience; use representative test sets, regression tests and human review where needed.

●Improve quality, latency and cost through retrieval/model comparisons, prompt and context tuning, caching, routing, token-usage controls and production feedback loops.

**4. Applied machine learning and data science**

● Guide the framing, development and validation of appropriate ML/statistical solutions such as classification, regression, forecasting, anomaly detection, clustering, NLP or optimization.

● Establish baselines and evaluation criteria; interpret results, investigate failure modes, check for data leakage and communicate limitations and confidence clearly.

● Partner with data engineers and analysts on data profiling, feature engineering, data pipelines, dataset quality, reproducibility and reliable access to data.

● Guide specialist computer-vision, OCR/intelligent document processing or multimodal work when required by the project portfolio; deep specialist research methods are not a blanket requirement for this role.

**5. Production engineering, cloud and MLOps / LLMOps**

●Build or guide production services and integrations using Python and REST APIs (FastAPI or equivalent), with appropriate validation, authentication, error handling, testing and documentation.

●Deploy and operate solutions in AWS or the agreed cloud platform. Relevant AWS services may include S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, RDS, Glue, EventBridge, Redshift, Lambda and container/orchestration services, depending on the architecture.

●Implement or oversee CI/CD, containerization, environment management, model/prompt/version tracking, automated tests, release controls, rollback and operational handover.

●Monitor application health and business/model quality, including latency, throughput, availability, cost, token consumption, retrieval quality, feedback signals and model/data drift where applicable.

● Own incident triage and root-cause analysis with engineering/platform teams; define fallback paths and support processes for customer-facing AI capabilities.

**6. Delivery management and stakeholder alignment**

●Own the delivery plan from discovery to launch: estimates, milestones, sprint/backlog priorities, resource needs, dependencies, risks, testing, UAT, release readiness and transition to support.

●Maintain a clear decision, action and risk log; provide concise progress updates; escalate issues early and propose options instead of only reporting blockers.

●Coordinate across customer teams, product/business analysts, data engineering, software engineering, QA, cloud/DevOps, security and domain experts.

●Ensure acceptance criteria and agreed business outcomes are met, and capture lessons learned and post-launch improvements

**7. Team leadership, governance and responsible AI**

● Coach and mentor AI engineers and data scientists; support work allocation, technical growth, feedback, code/model reviews and consistent quality standards.

●Apply appropriate data governance, privacy, access control, PII handling, audit logging, human review and responsible-AI safeguards based on use-case risk.

●Identify GenAI-specific risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool access, unintended data exposure, unsupported outputs and misuse; document mitigations and residual risks.

●Build reusable patterns, documentation and team practices that improve delivery predictability across multiple customer engagements

**Required Qualifications and experience:**

●5-6 years of relevant software engineering, AI/ML, data science or applied                        

AI experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on delivery experience.

●At least 2 years leading a technical team, delivery workstream or project; demonstrated ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

●At least 2 years in customer-facing or stakeholder-facing delivery, with evidence of running discovery workshops, clarifying requirements, presenting options and managing expectations.

●Strong Python engineering and practical SQL/data skills; understanding of testing, APIs, code quality and software engineering fundamentals.

●Strong applied ML/statistical reasoning and model evaluation skills, including the ability to choose baselines, validate results and explain limitations.

●At least 2 years building GenAI/LLM applications, including practical RAG experience; able to explain architecture, evaluation, failure modes and production trade-offs. At least one production deployment is strongly preferred.

●Working experience with AWS or the target cloud platform, and with model/application deployment, CI/CD, observability and production support.

●Experience with REST APIs using FastAPI or an equivalent Python web framework, and with at least one vector database or semantic-search technology when RAG is in scope.

●Strong communication, facilitation, documentation, mentoring and problem-solving skills.

●Hands-on experience with agentic/tool-using workflows, multimodal LLMs, VLMs, or more than one model provider.

●Computer vision, OCR, intelligent document processing, object detection, image segmentation or document-understanding experience where relevant to the client pipeline.

●Experience with model fine-tuning, embedding adaptation, open-source model serving or GPU/inference optimization.

●Familiarity with evaluation and tracing tools such as LangSmith, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent; equivalent tools are acceptable.

●Experience in consulting, professional services or multi-client delivery environments.

●Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may be considered.

**Company Website:**

https://aventior.com/

title: AI Engineer
description:
Keywords Studios is a leading global provider of technical and creative services to the video game and entertainment industries. With a network of over 70 studios across 26 countries, we partner with the world's most renowned game developers and publishers to deliver end-to-end solutions. Our expertise spans game development, art production, localization, audio services, functional and linguistic testing, and much more. At Keywords, we foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence, empowering our teams to create world-class gaming experiences that captivate audiences worldwide. In India, the company is headquartered in Gurgaon and has facilities in Bangalore and Pune. Join us in shaping the future of gaming and entertainment through technology!

****Role Overview****

We are looking for a passionate and skilled AI Engineer to build next-generation applications. You will play a key role in developing, deploying, and optimizing state-of-the-art Al models to power intelligent solutions that impact millions of users. This role heavily focuses on generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and integrating sophisticated agentic workflows into production environments.

**Requirements**
****Key Responsibilities****

●     Design, develop, and deploy advanced AI solutions focused on generative capabilities and conversational Al.

●     Build context-aware, autonomous AI agents using modern frameworks to solve complex business logic and automate workflows.

●     Collaborate with data engineers to preprocess and curate large datasets for training and testing models.

●     Experiment with state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms and fine-tune foundation models for production.

●     Build and deploy scalable, production-ready AI pipelines.

●     Analyze and optimize the performance of AI models to meet business requirements.

●     Stay updated with the latest advancements in GenAI, LLMs, and agentic systems, and propose innovative solutions to enhance products.

****Required Skills and Qualifications****

**Education:**
Bachelor's or Master's degree or PhD. in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

**Experience:**
3 to 6 years of professional experience in building ML/AI models with a focus on modern LLM implementations.

●    
**Technical Skills:**

○     Strong proficiency in Python and experience with advanced AI/LLM ecosystem libraries (e.g., transformers, vLLM, accelerate, PEFT/LoRA, or DSPy).

○     Experience in building and deploying RESTful APIs using
**FastAPI**
or
**Flask**
to serve AI models in production.

○     Strong expertise in building applications using LLMs (e.g., Gemini, GPT-4, Claude) and modern orchestration frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.

○     Hands-on experience with modern developer tools, including the Google AI SDK and OpenAI SDK, N8N.

○     Deep understanding of AI agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and how to orchestrate multi-agent systems.

○     Familiarity with vector databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and modern backend-as-a-service platforms like Supabase.

○     Knowledge of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to securely connect AI models with external data sources and tools.

○     Experience in developing and fine-tuning deep learning models using TensorFlow or PyTorch.

○     Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for deploying ML models.

●    
**Soft Skills:**

○     Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical mindset.

○     Excellent communication skills to convey complex ideas effectively.

○     Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

****Preferred Qualifications****

●     Knowledge about advanced prompt engineering techniques (e.g., Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought, ReAct) is a strong good-to-have.

●     Experience with fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) for domain-specific tasks.

●     Exposure to multimodal learning (integrating vision and language models).

●     Knowledge of LLMOps/MLOps practices, including containerization and CI/CD pipelines.

●     Publications or contributions to open-source projects in modern AI domains.

**Benefits**
****What We Offer****

●     Competitive salary and performance bonuses.

●     Opportunity to work on exciting, cutting-edge projects.

●     Flexible working hours and a collaborative environment.

●     Professional growth opportunities through training and mentorship.

●     Health insurance, Learning budgets, etc.

●     Disconnect Week during Christmas to new year.

**Preferred locations, in order: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune.**
**Role purpose**
Build and improve AI, data or enterprise engineering solutions for Ascendion clients. Turn a business
  
  
requirement into tested working software, explain your choices and take responsibility for the work
  
  
you deliver.
  
  
Expected outcomes
  
  

* Deliver assigned components that meet agreed tests and client acceptance criteria, with clear

documentation and a usable handover.
  
  

* Demonstrate how your work improves a user workflow, system quality or delivery effort, and explain

the evidence and remaining limitations.

* Clarify requirements with client engineers and domain experts. Propose practical options and

connect implementation choices to the business problem.
  
  

* Build, debug, integrate and test solutions. Follow work through release and resolve issues in the

components you own.
  
  

* Collaborate with Ascendion teams, technology partners and alliances to resolve dependencies and

earn client trust through reliable delivery.

choices, tests, failures and results.
  
  

* Experience clarifying stakeholder needs and explaining recommendations. Show both practical

solutions. Explain model or retrieval quality, failure cases and how outputs are checked.

or executive presentation.

* Open-source work, internal tools or other evidence of self-directed building; applied AI governance,

Ethical AI or Responsible AI experience.

Preferred locations, in order: Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune. Work from an Ascendion office
  
  
or client location; permanent work from home is not offered. Travel within India and internationally for
  
  
client engagements and conferences is required.

description:

If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**About the Role**
We are looking for a skilled
**Avaloq Technical Business Analyst**
who will work closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and implementation partners to translate business requirements into high-quality Avaloq solutions. description:
**Role: Senior Business Analyst / Product Analyst**

**Location: Pune/ Nagpur, Maharashtra - Onsite Office**

**Duration: Fulltime**

**Experience: 8 to 10 years**

**Working Hours: UK time shift**

**Notice Period: Immediate Joiners Only**

**Must Have: Clinical domain exp, Clinical Trials, Clinical Operations, Clinical Reviews.**

**Job Description:**

**Clinical Data Review & Decision Support Platform**

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking experienced Business Analysts/Product Analysts to join a team responsible for an enterprise-grade data review and decision-support platform used across the clinical development lifecycle. The platform supports multiple user personas, including Clinical Programmers, Central Monitors, Medical Reviewers, Data Managers, and Analytical Monitors, helping them review, analyze, and act on data from a variety of clinical systems.
* These roles will serve as dedicated partners to specific user groups, acting as the voice of the customer and bringing deep understanding of workflows, challenges, and opportunities back to the product and engineering teams. The goal is to ensure solutions are grounded in real-world user needs and drive measurable improvements in review efficiency, data quality, and decision making.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Develop a deep understanding of end-to-end workflows for assigned user personas and become a trusted partner for those stakeholder groups.

• Gather, analyze, and translate business needs into well-defined product requirements, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria.

• Partner closely with users to identify pain points, inefficiencies, usability challenges, and enhancement opportunities.

• Facilitate workshops, requirement discussions, demos, feedback sessions, and solution reviews.

• Collaborate with Product Managers, UX designers, engineers, data teams, and business stakeholders to shape and prioritize solutions.

• Analyze complex business processes spanning multiple systems, data sources, and teams.

• Support backlog refinement, release planning, user acceptance testing, and change management activities.

• Monitor adoption, user feedback, and operational metrics to identify continuous improvement opportunities.

**Required Qualifications:**

• 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Functional Analyst, or similar role supporting enterprise software products or platforms.

• Strong experience translating business needs into product requirements and working within Agile product delivery models.

• Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities where AI can address business needs and to propose practical AI-enabled solutions, including defining requirements, human-in-the-loop workflows, and measurable business outcomes in collaboration with product, engineering, and data/AI teams.

• Demonstrated ability to engage with diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data and insights.

• Experience working on workflow-intensive platforms, operational applications, data-driven products, or decision-support systems.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Experience creating process maps, user journeys, requirements documentation, and user stories.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

• Experience in clinical research, life sciences, healthcare, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or regulated environments.

• Familiarity with clinical data review, risk-based monitoring, central monitoring, data management, medical review, or trial operations workflows.

• [GOOD TO HAVE] Experience with commercial or industry platforms such as Medidata Detect, CluePoints, IQVIA technologies, Elluminate, Clinical Insights platforms, or similar clinical review and analytics solutions.

• Understanding of data visualization, reporting, analytics, and workflow management tools.

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Lead Business Analyst
  
  
**Overview**
The Revenue Operations & Enablement team is looking for a Lead Business Analyst to support key systems such as Contra Revenue Systems (CRS) and FundApp, Mastercard’s Fund Administration platform. This role will operate as the connective tissue between Finance stakeholders and Technology, using a Revenue platform operating model focused on structured intake, clear requirements, prioritization, release readiness, UAT coordination, production support, issue triage, documentation, reporting oversight, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, analytical, comfortable working across business and technical teams, and able to bring structure to a growing platform support model. The role requires strong project management discipline, application support experience, consulting mindset, and the ability to communicate clearly while independently managing priorities across multiple projects and support efforts.
  
  
Role
  
  
**In This Position, You Will:**

* Serve as the primary Lead BA and platform liaison for FundApp and CRS, connecting Finance and Technology stakeholders to ensure clear ownership, requirements, priorities, and delivery outcomes.
* Manage system enhancements, projects, strategy inputs, setup/configuration needs, application support, and related operational support activities.
* Translate business needs into clear business requirements, technical requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, reporting needs, and decision documentation that Technology can design, build, test, and support.
* Partner with key business users to provide application overviews, explain new functionality, assess automation opportunities, and support user training or adoption needs.
* Collaborate with internal technical teams to facilitate and test issue resolution, confirm expected system behavior, and align business requirements with technical delivery plans.
* Provide ongoing production support, including problem management, root cause analysis, ticket logging, business impact communication, status updates, and escalation as needed.
* Lead evaluation efforts for new capabilities, process improvements, workflow changes, or related functionality based on business requirements and governance priorities.
* Coordinate UAT, regression testing, business validation, release communications, patching/upgrades/enhancement testing, and post-implementation checks to ensure system updates perform as intended.
* Ensure configuration documentation, process documentation, training guides, decision logs, and support materials are updated as application changes or new functionality are introduced.
* Support SOX and audit compliance by helping maintain control documentation, supporting control testing, identifying improvement opportunities, and ensuring platform changes align to accounting policy, controls, and reporting expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying manual work, data quality gaps, reporting limitations, control risks, user training needs, and opportunities to simplify the system support model as adoption and platform complexity grow.

**All About You**
The ideal candidate for this position should:
  
  

* Have advanced business analysis experience supporting enterprise business platforms, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Fund Administration, billing, order-to-cash, rebates/incentives, or related operational systems.
* Hold a Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.
* Understand general accounting practices, financial controls, reporting processes, and multi-currency business environments.
* Be skilled at bridging business and Technology teams, translating complex operational needs into simple, actionable requirements, and keeping both sides aligned through design, testing, release, and support.
* Understand platform governance disciplines, including intake management, backlog prioritization, issue triage, release planning, UAT coordination, documentation, control readiness, and operational reporting.
* Be comfortable working with Finance stakeholders on forecasting, spend tracking, actuals, accruals, reporting, reconciliations, fund controls, audit support, and executive governance needs.
* Demonstrate strong project management discipline, including prioritization, follow-through, issue/risk tracking, status communication, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with global stakeholders, including the ability to lead working sessions, ask structured questions, explain technical issues in business language, and create concise decision-ready materials.
* Quickly engage and influence business partners, drive change constructively, and build strong relationships within a multinational organization.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, curiosity, judgment, and follow-through; proactively identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, escalate risks appropriately, and help create a scalable operating model rather than only solving one-off issues.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Coupa and/or Oracle knowledge, particularly where fund administration, procurement, purchase order, invoice, general ledger, reporting, or downstream finance processes intersect.
* Experience with Revenue platforms, Rebates & Incentives, billing systems, order-to-cash processes, or other financial applications that require disciplined intake, release, testing, production support, and control oversight.
* Experience with Salesforce, Hyperion, Power BI, Jira, Remedy, SharePoint, Confluence, or similar enterprise workflow, reporting, collaboration, and support tools.
* Familiarity with financial controls, audit/SOX readiness, reporting standardization, data quality, and cross-functional operating models.
* Experience supporting global teams and stakeholders across time zones, including Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Tax, Compliance, and Controllership partners.
* Ability to build lightweight governance artifacts such as RACIs, intake models, release checklists, issue logs, decision trees, status reports, training guides, configuration documentation, and stakeholder communication plans.

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Come With An Inherent Risk To The Organization. Therefore, It Is Expected That The Successful Candidate For This Position Must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and acceptance sign-offs.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and key risk indicators (KRIs) to quantify product adoption, operational STP (Straight-Through Processing) rates, and risk mitigation.
* Champion best-in-class product management practices, ensuring adherence to change governance, SDLC frameworks, and audit controls.

Job Description Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst (Assistant Vice President)
  
  
The Applications Development Senior Programmer Analyst is an intermediate level position responsible for participation in the establishment and implementation of new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to applications systems analysis and programming activities, significantly augmented by Artificial Intelligence capabilities
  
  
About the Role: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Assistant Vice President (AVP), Software Senior Engineer, to join our dynamic team. This role is crucial for designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable middleware solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, coupled with a strong understanding of database technologies such as Oracle, SQL, and MongoDB. Furthermore, we are looking for an individual with a keen interest and demonstrable exposure to Artificial Intelligence (AI) and a passion for leveraging AI to drive productivity gains, innovate our software development processes, and enhance solution quality. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our technical landscape, mentoring junior engineers, and contributing to high-impact projects through an AI-first development approach.
  
  
**Responsibilities (Leveraging AI):**
 Lead the design, development, and implementation of complex middleware applications using Java and Spring Boot: Utilize AI-powered code generation tools (e.g., Devin, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate development, automate boilerplate code, suggest optimal implementations, and enforce architectural patterns. Leverage AI for design pattern identification and complex system architecture validation.
  
  
 Architect and optimize database interactions with Oracle, SQL, and MongoDB, ensuring high performance and data integrity: Employ AI to analyze database query performance, suggest advanced indexing strategies, optimize schema designs, and generate eƯicient SQL/NoSQL queries. AI-driven tools can also assist in predicting database load and recommending scaling solutions.
  
  
 Drive the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines to facilitate rapid and reliable software delivery: Integrate AI into CI/CD processes for intelligent test case generation, predictive failure analysis, automated code vulnerability scanning, and optimization of pipeline execution times based on historical data.
  
  
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to define requirements, design solutions, and deliver high-quality software:
  
  
 Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning: Leverage AI platforms for personalized learning paths, automated code feedback, and explanations of complex technical concepts. Encourage junior engineers to adopt AI-driven development practices.
  
  
 Actively research and experiment with AI technologies to identify opportunities for enhancing developer productivity, automating tasks, and improving software quality: Continuously explore emerging AI tools and techniques (such as Anti Gravity for complex problem-solving) and assess their applicability to our development ecosystem
  
  
 Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards, best practices, and architectural guidelines: Utilize AI-powered code analysis tools to pre-scan code for potential bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, and style deviations, allowing human reviewers to focus on higher-level logic and design.
  
  
 Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring the stability and performance of production systems: Implement AI-driven anomaly detection in monitoring systems, leverage AI for rapid log analysis and root cause identification, and automate incident response workflows.
  
  
 Contribute to the strategic planning and technical roadmap for our middleware platforms: Employ AI to analyze industry trends, forecast technology evolution, assess the impact of new features, and prioritize roadmap initiatives based on data-driven insights.
  
  
 Conduct tasks related to feasibility studies, time and cost estimates, IT planning, risk technology, applications development, and model development: Utilize AI for data synthesis, predictive modeling for estimations, identification of potential IT risks, and accelerated model prototyping and validation
  
  
 Monitor and control all phases of the development process (analysis, design, construction, testing, and implementation) and provide user and operational support: Implement AI-driven dashboards and reporting for real-time project health, automated progress tracking, and proactive identification of development lifecycle bottlenecks.
  
  
 Utilize in-depth specialty knowledge of applications development to analyze complex problems/issues, provide evaluation of business process, system process, and industry standards, and make evaluative judgment: Augment human analytical capabilities with AI-powered data analysis and pattern recognition to rapidly assess complex scenarios and inform robust decision-making.
  
  
 Recommend and develop security measures in post-implementation analysis of business usage to ensure successful system design and functionality: Use AI-driven security analysis tools to continuously monitor applications for vulnerabilities, predict potential threats, and recommend adaptive security control.
  
  
**Required Technical Skill:**
 Core Java: Strong understanding of Java (JDK 8+, preferably Java 11/17), including multithreading, collections, garbage collection, and JVM internals.  Frameworks: Extensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security).  Middleware: Proven experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  
  
 Database Technologies (Must): o Relational Databases: Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with Oracle databases, including schema design, query optimization, and stored procedures. o NoSQL Databases: Experience with MongoDB, including data modeling, querying, and performance tuning.
  
  
 CI/CD & DevOps: Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools and practices (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Maven/Gradle, Docker, Kubernetes).
  
  
 Version Control: Proficiency with Git and standard branching strategies (e.g., Gitflow).
  
  
 Testing: Experience with unit testing frameworks (JUnit, Mockito) and integration testing.
  
  
** AI Tools & Methodologies (Must have exposure):**

* Demonstrable exposure and practical experience with AI development tools such as Devin, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Anti Gravity, and Codex.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, and integrating AI into software development workflows (e.g., for code generation, testing, debugging, and documentation).

 Experience in systems analysis and programming of software applications, demonstrating success in leveraging AI for efficiency and quality.
  
  
 Experience in managing and implementing successful projects, including those utilizing AI driven development approaches.
  
  
 Working knowledge of consulting/project management techniques/methods, adaptable to AI-accelerated project lifecycles.
  
  
 AI certification is plus

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead.
  
  
Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!
  
  
**Description**
We are looking for a seasoned full-stack engineer to build and manage entire Mobile and Web infrastructure. Successful candidates should have a minimum of 2 years of experience in below skills.
  
  
Candidates should have knowledge and experience in web development technologies like Angular, Typescript, Ionic and ReactJS. Development experience of Hybrid Web Applications Compatible with Desktop, iOS, and Android mobile Platforms will be added advantage.

* Participate in peer code reviews.

* Develop solutions for cloud – Azure.
